cases.case_label: Founder SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP) - age-at-onset modifier GWAS
cases.mechanism_detail: All patients carry the ~2.6-kb founder SVA in TAF1 intron 32; this GWAS identifies modifiers of age at onset (near MSH3, PMS2) likely acting via repeat instability, and does not study the insertion's molecular effect on TAF1.
cases.quote: All patients carry the same disease-causing mutation, a ~2.6-kb SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA)-type retrotransposon insertion in intron 32 of the TAF1 gene2,3.
